subject: Error installing rgdal library on glimmer?

messages.author: 36124ef81e5e54e4
messages.subject: Error installing rgdal library on glimmer?
parts:
Hi, 

I've got a shiny app that requires use of the rgdal library for reading .gpx files. It works fine on my local machine using RStudio but I have been unable to install the rgdal library in my glimmer RStudio workspace. All other required libraries have installed without a hitch. I get the error message below. Is it possible to install this library on the glimmer server?

By the way, shiny is incredible.........Thanks!

* installing *source* package ‘rgdal’ ...
** package ‘rgdal’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
configure: rgdal: 0.7-28
./configure: line 1336: svnversion: command not found
configure: svn revision: 
configure: gdal-config: gdal-config
checking gdal-config usability... 
./configure: line 1365: gdal-config: command not found
no

Error: gdal-config not found
The gdal-config script distributed with GDAL could not be found.
If you have not installed the GDAL libraries, you can
download the source from  http://www.gdal.org/
If you have installed the GDAL libraries, then make sure that
gdal-config is in your path. Try typing gdal-config at a
shell prompt and see if it runs. If not, use:
 --configure-args='--with-gdal-config=/usr/local/bin/gdal-config'
with appropriate values for your installation.
